newsitem.title: USA: TWA to cut some fares by 50 percent or more.
newsitem.headline: TWA to cut some fares by 50 percent or more.

text.p: Trans World Airlines on Wednesday said it would cut some late-spring fares on U.S. routes and on flights between the United States and Toronto by at least 50 percent.
Also, the carrier will cut fares on flights to Milan, Italy, Madrid and Rome by up to 35 percent, it said.
The special fares, which are non-refundable, are valid for travel on U.S. and Toronto routes between May 8 and June 15, while the other fares are valid between May 8 and June 30, the airline said.
Tickets must be purchased at least seven days before departure and within 72 hours of booking, and must be purchased by May 7, the airline said.
